# Model selection

We choose the radial SVM as our final model, because it reached the highest
cross-validated accuracy (92.3%). It was also the most stable across folds (SD of 3.5 percentage points), 
and it clearly outperforms the human benchmark of 74.4%.

```{r select-model}
final_model <- models[[model_comparison$model[1]]]
cat("Selected model:", model_comparison$model[1], "\n")
```

## Important features

```{r feature-importance, code=readLines("R/visualization/importance.R"), fold="Feature importance", message=FALSE}
source("R/visualization/importance.R", local = TRUE, print.eval = TRUE)
```

```{r}
plot_feature_importance(final_model, top = 30)
```
